name: Nadrian (Ned) C. Seeman

summary: Author of the obituary, affiliated with Budapest University of Technology and Economics.

name: Balazs Hargittai
summary: Author of the obituary, affiliated with Saint Francis University.

summary: Crystallographer at Massachusetts Institute of Technology who supervised Seeman's postdoctoral work.

name: Robin Holliday
summary: Molecular biologist who described the Holliday junction in 1964.

summary: Pioneer of nanoscience at IBM Almaden Research Center, co-recipient of the 2010 Kavli Prize with Seeman.

summary: University where Seeman completed his undergraduate and PhD studies.

summary: University where Seeman conducted postdoctoral work.

summary: Institute where Seeman conducted postdoctoral work with Alexander Rich.
